name: dvstack
description: Three plugins, one call each: Playwright tests, a font switcher, and AGENTS.md for how a coding agent should behave in a repo.

plugins.name: dvstack-frontend
plugins.description: A drop-in font switcher. Copy the skill's source into the app; do not reimplement it.

plugins.name: dvstack-testing
plugins.description: Opinionated Playwright house conventions: suite architecture and naming with copyable templates, step validation and flaky-test fixes, a house-rules review checklist with ESLint config, and Playwright agents/MCP review.

plugins.name: dvstack-agents
plugins.description: Adds the global rules agents skip into an AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md that already exists, and keeps only the pasted rules this repo needs.
